text:
There is a place beside

the Tiscapa lagoon


—a boat beneath

a quelite tree—


that you know

(the one to whom I write


these verses will know

that they are for her)


And you remember

that bench and

that quelite;


The moon reflected

in the Tiscapa lagoon,


The lights of the palace

of the dictator


the frogs singing

down in the lagoon


That quelite

tree is still there


The same lights

are still shining;


In the Tiscapa lagoon

the moon is reflected;


But that bench

tonight will be empty


Or with another couple

who are not us.

translation.title: There Is a Place Beside
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps Tiscapa's repeated lights and moon while the remembered bench loses the lovers.
